rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person belonging to a group or organization.

example.english: They are a member of our band.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ngok6 deoi6 ge3 sing4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for a member of a club, association, service, or other membership organization.

example.english: I finally became a member of the gym.
example.traditional: 我尋日終於成為咗健身會嘅會員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 zung1 jyu1 seng4 wai4 zo2 gin6 san1 wui6 ge3 wui2 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when the group is a team, especially in sports or a competition.

example.english: I joined the school basketball team and became a member.
example.traditional: 我加入學校籃球隊，成為隊員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 jap6 hok6 haau6 laam4 kau4 deoi6 seng4 wai4 deoi6 jyun4
